structuredContent.description: A tiny simple UI loading indicator, isolated transparent background, 16x16 pixel art. Three separated cool sky-blue small block-shaped segments orbit an empty central space, one open quadrant, visually balanced compact silhouette. Looks like ongoing work, not completion: no check mark, no arrowhead, no text, no panel, no shadow. Clean deliberate pixel clusters readable at native 16px next to a minimal blue check mark. This is the first pose of a four-frame rotating activity loop.
